games.description:
🃏 Durak Online is an online card game played by over 10 million players!

🎮 Game Features
• 📱 User-friendly interface with device rotation support
• 🌐 Online play only with real people, 2 to 6 players
• 🃏 Deck size: 24, 36, or 52 cards
• 📜 Classic rules: "Throw-in Durak" or "Transfer Durak"
• ↗️ "Neighbors throw" or "Everyone throws" modes
• ➕ Option to throw more than one card at a time
• 🔄 Option to repeat the game with the same players
• ↩️ Option to undo a random card throw
• 🤝 Draw

⚙️ Flexible game mode selection
By combining various settings, you can play one of a variety of modes. You have access to:

1️⃣ Number of players. Online games are available for 2-6 players. You choose how many people will play Durak with you.

2️⃣ Deck size. A shortened deck (24 cards) is available for 2-4 players, as well as 36- and 52-card decks.

3️⃣ Throw-in Durak. Transfer Durak. In a game of Throw-in Durak, after a player has beaten a card, the caller or one of the players may place (throw in, throw up) one or more additional cards of any suit whose value matches the value of any of the cards already involved in the current turn. When playing transfer Durak, the rules are the same, but the player who is playing can not only cover cards but also (before starting their turn) transfer the lead to the player sitting to their left with a card of the same rank as the lead.

4️⃣ "Neighbors Throw" or "Everyone Throws" options. These two modes are available for both transfer Durak and transfer Durak. When playing "Neighbors Throw," only players sitting next to you can throw additional cards. If you play Durak with the "Everyone Throw" mode, any player can throw.

5️⃣ Fair Play or "With Cheaters." In fair play, the server monitors the fairness of the cards. When playing "With Cheaters," the players monitor the fairness. Catch the cheaters, mark them, and they won't be able to cheat you again!

6️⃣ Classic game or "Draw" option. When choosing classic rules, the last player left with cards loses. In the "Draw" option, you can win back your last cards.

7️⃣ Two speed modes for those who don't like waiting and for those who like to calculate every move.

👥 Private Durak game with friends
• 🔒 Add people you play with as friends. Chat with them, invite them to play Durak online.
• 🔑 Create games and invite friends to play together.
• 🌍 When creating a game without a password, any player online can join you to play Durak.
• 💬 If you want to play with friends, create a game with a password and invite them to it. If you want to not only play with friends but also invite other players to fill all the empty slots, simply open the game by clicking the button.

🏆 Player Rankings
For each victory in the game, you earn a rating. The higher your rating, the higher your place on the Leaderboard. The game has several seasons: Autumn, Winter, Spring, June, July, and August. Compete for first place in a season or top the all-time player rankings. Get a higher rating in premium games. Play several days in a row and increase the rating you earn for each win with a daily bonus.

🎯 Achievements
You can not only play Durak online, but also make the game more interesting by earning achievements. The game offers achievements of varying focus and difficulty levels.

games.name: My Fairy Garden
games.description:
【My Fariy Garden】 — Sebuah perjalanan menenangkan yang memadukan berkebun, seni merangkai bunga, dan didampingi peri-peri lucu. Di sini, setiap benih menyimpan cerita, setiap pertemuan terasa hangat.

Kelola Taman Impian, dari Benih hingga Mekar
 Mulai dari sepetak tanah kecil, buka lahan, tabur benih, sirami, dan rawat setiap tanaman dengan penuh perhatian. Perlahan kembangkan taman Anda, desain jalur berkelok, lansekap yang bertingkat, dan ciptakan sendiri sudut dongeng di hutan tempat bunga bermekaran sepanjang musim.

Koleksi Bunga Ajaib, Ciptakan Hadiah Bunga Artistik
 Jelajahi dan kumpulkan berbagai bunga istimewa, buka koleksi lengkapnya. Tumpahkan kreativitas artistik Anda, rangkai bunga-bunga hasil panen secara bebas menjadi buket, keranjang bunga, dan dekorasi bunga yang indah. Ubah hadiah dari hutan menjadi karya yang layak disimpan.

Temui Sahabat Peri, Rajut Ikatan Hangat
 Banyak peri kecil yang polos dan ceria tinggal di hutan. Temukan dan ajak mereka ke rumah Anda. Mereka tidak hanya bisa membantu merawat tanaman, setiap peri juga memiliki kepribadian dan cerita uniknya sendiri, menunggu untuk dibuka dengan kehangatan dan pendampingan Anda.

Hias Ruang Pribadi, Definisikan Gaya yang Beragam
 Banyak pilihan pakaian dan furnitur untuk Anda padukan! Dari apron berkebun yang segar hingga gaun mewah bergaya hutan, dari dekorasi interior yang hangat hingga komponen taman yang unik. Tentukan citra pribadi dan gaya rumah Anda secara bebas, tunjukkan selera yang tak tertandingi.

Bagikan Momen Santai, Nikmati Interaksi Saling Bantu
 Kunjungi rumah hutan milik teman, bantu merawat tanaman satu sama lain, bertukar inspirasi dekorasi, atau selesaikan misi kolaborasi khusus bersama. Berbagi sukacita panen dalam interaksi yang mudah dan menyenangkan, agar perjalanan tidak lagi terasa sepi.

Hutan yang ditenun dari mimpi, bunga, dan kehangatan ini sedang menunggu pemiliknya dengan damai. Mulailah perjalanan Anda sekarang, tabur benih pertama Anda, temui sahabat peri pertama Anda, dan tenunlah dongeng penuh kehangatan milik Anda sendiri dengan kedua tangan Anda! Ayo!

games.name: Ludo Super King
games.description:
Gameplay: Players take turns placing one card on the center of the deck. If, after placing a card, the top card of the deck has the same rank as a card below it, that player collects all cards between those two. The player who collects the most cards wins.

Players need to remember and calculate the "buried" cards and trigger the collection at the right time. A novel way to play, come and try it out!

games.name: Letter Tile Match - Word Games
games.description:
Letter Tile Match is a word puzzle game that combines classic word-building with match mechanics. Form words from letter tiles to break obstacles and complete level goals in a limited number of moves. Each correct word you submit removes tiles from the board, clears nearby objects, and opens space for new letter tiles to fall from above.

In this word game, the aim is to build real words using the letters on the board. The selected letter tiles disappear, obstacles next to and beneath them break, and the grid refills with new tiles. Every move changes the board and creates new opportunities to find words and clear space with the reaction caused by a tile match.

Letter Tile Match blends classic word puzzle games with the strategy of matching games. Plan each move carefully, choose words that clear maximum space, and meet your objective before you run out of moves. This matching game rewards smart decisions and analytical play. Inspired by the word search genre and word connect games, this free word game for adults offers a fresh take on puzzle gameplay with tile matching.

How to play this letter game

• The goal of this word puzzle is to meet level objectives within a limited number of moves.
• Look at the board and find words using the available letter tiles.
• Tap Submit to remove the selected letter tiles from the grid.
• Obstacles next to removed letters break, and ice beneath the tiles cracks.
• New letter tiles fall from above and create new opportunities to make a tile match.
• Longer words unlock boosters and help clear difficult sections of the board.
• You can't pass a level if you run out of moves before meeting the goal.

How to master this letter-matching game

• Look for longer words that will clear more tiles and free up space on the board.
• Target concentrated groups of obstacles so that one word can break several objects in one go.
• Save simple words for later when you might need a safe move to finish the level.
• Plan ahead and make every move count in this strategic matching game.

Letter Tile Match combines relaxing word games for adults with the satisfying mechanics of match games and tile match puzzles. Matching games for adults and thoughtful word puzzles come together in this game to create a calm and rewarding challenge.

Play Letter Tile Match to find words, solve various levels, and train your brain with engaging word puzzle games.

games.name: Color Flow - Block Buster
games.description:
Color Flow: Block Buster involves breaking through a layered surface to uncover hidden images. Players interact with a grid-like barrier, using projectiles to dismantle the exterior and reveal a collection of vibrant visuals beneath.
Gameplay Overview
The core objective is to clear a covering grid to reveal a hidden background. Players launch projectiles at the surface barrier. Upon impact, the sections of the grid break away, allowing liquid elements to flood into the vacated spaces.

As the barrier is dismantled, the underlying image becomes visible. A level is successfully completed once the entire grid has been removed and the background is fully exposed. Each stage features different structural layouts, requiring players to direct their impacts effectively to clear the surface and complete the image.

Key Features
Break and Reveal Mechanic: A system where dismantling the top layer leads to the gradual unveiling of a hidden background.

Dynamic Infill: Liquid elements that instantly saturate empty areas as soon as the surface segments are removed.

Precision Impacts: Players must direct strikes toward specific coordinates on the grid to ensure total coverage.

Diverse Visual Library: Numerous stages featuring a wide variety of unique images to be uncovered.

Structural Progression: Each level offers different grid configurations, changing the way the surface must be cleared.

Visual Feedback: Clear transitions that illustrate the progress from a covered surface to a completed reveal.

Experience the process of uncovering hidden images in Color Flow: Block Buster. Color Shooter Flow

• سهل: (٢٠٠ نقطة)
• متوسط: (٤٠٠ نقطة)

• اللعب عبر الإنترنت: أنشئ غرفتك الخاصة، شارك الرمز مع أصدقائك، وتحدَّهم عن بُعد مع ميزة المحادثة الصوتية المباشرة لتشعروا وكأنكم في نفس الغرفة!
مميزات اللعبة
• غرف لعب خاصة ومغلقة لضمان الخصوصية مع الأصدقاء.
• محادثة صوتية (مايكروفون) مباشرة مدمجة داخل اللعبة.
• فئات أسئلة متنوعة (ثقافة عامة، رياضة، تاريخ، والمزيد...).
• مؤثرات بصرية وتصميم تفاعلي يرفع من حماس الجلسة.
• إمكانية شراء "النسخة الكاملة" لفتح جميع الفئات والمفاجآت للعب بلا حدود.
هل أنت مستعد لتكون "بطل الجلسة"؟
حمل "٣ كروت" الآن، جهز فريقك، واستمتع بأقوى جلسة تحدي وضحك!

games.name: Gap Impulse
games.description:
I. Core Game Objective​
Precisely shoot bullets to hit target balls marked with matching numbers, eliminate them to unlock the next level's target, and avoid touching the surrounding lines of the target balls throughout the game to successfully clear all levels.​
II. Basic Operation Methods​
Shoot Bullets: No need to adjust the direction (the shooting direction is fixed). Simply tap any area on the screen to fire a bullet. The bullet will fly straight along the preset fixed path, aiming at the target ball area.​
Target Locking: After entering a level, a target ball marked with a clear number (e.g., 1-9) will appear in the center of the screen. The target ball is surrounded by closed colored lines (boundary lines), which are dangerous areas to avoid.​
Elimination Rules: Bullets are marked with numbers corresponding to the current level's target. Only when the number on the fired bullet exactly matches the number on the target ball will the target ball be successfully eliminated upon impact. After elimination, the next target ball (with a randomly changing number) will be unlocked automatically, starting a new round of challenges.​
III. Win/Loss Judgment Rules​
Failure Conditions: If the fired bullet fails to hit the target ball, or if it touches or collides with the surrounding boundary lines of the target ball, the current round will be deemed a failure, and you will need to retry the level. Match numbers, shoot fixed-direction bullets avoid boundaries, eliminate balls

Timing and color matching are everything. As levels progress, you will face:

Relaxing Visuals, Addictive Gameplay

• Mesmerizing sand flow physics with smooth cascading effects
• Beautiful pixel art pictures that dissolve into colorful sand
• Magical potion-style cauldrons with sparkling effects
• Gentle pace and calming visuals for a relaxing experience

Whether you want a quick brain game break or a long, relaxing puzzle session, Magic Sand Sort delivers an addictive and calming color sort experience unlike any other.

Features of This Color Sort Puzzle Game
• Hundreds of handcrafted levels with unique pixel art designs
• Progressive difficulty from easy to expert
• Satisfying sand physics and magical visual effects
• Simple controls with deep strategic gameplay

Easy to Learn, Hard to Master

The rules take seconds to grasp: match colors, fill cauldrons, sort the sand. But mastering the timing and color strategy takes real skill, patience, and clever thinking. Magic Sand Sort is the ultimate sand sort brain puzzle wrapped in pixel art magic and zen-like flow.

Blast Trivia favors steady pacing over long tutorials. The question card stays central, answers sit beneath it, and the header keeps the timer and resources in view. If you want a compact trivia session with a predictable structure, Blast Trivia offers a fixed-length path when you clear every card and an earlier stop when mistakes add up, with immediate visual responses after each choice.

The questions in Blast Trivia cover familiar school-day topics and general knowledge, written for quick reading on a phone. Blast Trivia is written for a general audience and avoids graphic or aggressive themes in its text. Blast Trivia bundles scores, lives, timers, and a tidy recap into one self-contained round after another.

Session details in Blast Trivia update while you play so the results summary can show consistent numbers when the round completes. Blast Trivia stays approachable whether you play a single round or several in one sitting, with the same scoring and life rules whenever you return. • Use special action cards to flip, block, stack, and change category

You Know: Associations combines the instant fun of a classic card game with strategic gameplay and satisfying card connect action. Every hand gives you new combinations to explore. Every round of card association challenges you to think ahead, manage risk, and hold the right cards for the perfect moment. If you like a card game that rewards smart choices, this is the card association game to download.

HOW TO PLAY

Play one card at a time by matching the top card on the discard pile. You can match by category or by colour. If you cannot play, draw a card. Power Cards let you reverse the turn order, skip the next player, or make them draw cards. Special Cards let you change the category or put even more pressure on your opponents.

Stacking adds even more excitement. When a Take 2 or Change Category & Take 4 card is played, the next player can answer with another penalty card instead of drawing. This creates bigger combinations and raises the total until someone cannot continue. That player takes all stacked cards and loses their turn. These high-pressure moments make every card game round more intense and strategic.

Win by playing all your cards or by finishing with the lowest score when the game ends. Base Cards are worth 5 points, Power Cards are worth 20, and Special Cards are worth 50. Strong card association strategy, careful combinations, and smart card connect decisions are the key to victory. Place in the top 2 to earn coins, build your balance, and join more matches.

Levels take 2-5 minutes — perfect for a commute, a coffee break, or "just one more level" at midnight. But the card strategy and combo discovery keep you theorycrafting between sessions. This is a casual tower defense game with real strategic depth.


FEATURES

games.name: Card Associations

Card Associations is a relaxed card puzzle where words replace traditional playing cards. Build classic combinations, discover hidden connections, and score points by grouping cards that belong together.

Easy to learn, strategic to master, and perfect for quick sessions.

🧩 How to Play
-Draw cards from the deck
-Look for matching categories and colors
-Build strong card combinations
-Submit your hand to score points
-Reach the target score before you run out of hands

Every level challenges you to think differently and make the most of the cards you draw.

⭐ Create Powerful Combos
Score points by building familiar card-style combinations using categories:
• One Pair – two cards from the same category
• Two Pair – two different category pairs
• Three of a Kind – three matching categories
• Full House – a trio plus a pair
• Four of a Kind – four cards from one category
• Monochrome – five cards of the same color

Choosing when to submit a hand and when to draw again is the key to winning.

🧠 Plan Your Strategy
Each run gives you a different mix of categories and colors, encouraging new strategies every time you play. Use your draws carefully and look for the best possible combinations.

Simple rules, satisfying decisions, and clever puzzle moments make every level rewarding.

⚡ Helpful Power-Ups
When the cards don't go your way, use tools to adjust your hand:
• Undo a draw and recover your previous card
• Peek at upcoming cards in the deck
• Modify a card’s category or color
• Add an extra card to your hand
• Use special effects to create stronger combinations

Power-ups give you more ways to shape your strategy.

🎖 Progress, Unlocks & Special Cards
As you progress, you’ll unlock achievements, collect stars, and gain access to helpful charms that modify gameplay in subtle ways.

Charms provide passive bonuses that enhance your strategy, such as increasing points for certain combinations or improving your draws.

Special cards also introduce new twists to each puzzle. Some cards can double your score, others may appear face-down until revealed, while certain cards bring unique challenges like locked slots or cards that cannot be held between draws.

These evolving elements add variety and keep every run fresh.

🌿 Relaxing Puzzle Gameplay
Casual and easy to learn
Short, satisfying levels
Strategic card combinations
Offline play supported

Perfect for quick sessions anywhere

🎯 Think, combine, and score.
Download Card Associations and discover a fresh take on classic card combinations with a clever word-based twist. Match cards. Build combos. Score big. Poker with a twist.

games.name: Snack Sweep
games.description:
I. Core Game Mechanics​
This is a casual puzzle mobile game that combines shelf organization and match-3 elimination. The core goal is to clear all goods from the shelves — experience the satisfying and therapeutic fun of organizing through strategic movement and matching.​
Core Rules:​
Shelf Layer Logic: Each shelf contains multiple layers of goods. Only the outermost layer of goods is clickable and operable; when the outer goods are eliminated or moved, the goods behind will automatically move forward to unlock a new operable layer.​
Match-3 Trigger Condition: The "front row" of any shelf grid can stack up to 3 goods. When these 3 goods are of the same type, they will be automatically eliminated to free up space.​
Clearance Requirement: Eliminate all layers of goods on the shelves with no leftovers to successfully clear the level. The difficulty increases progressively as you advance (more shelf layers and additional types of goods).​
II. Basic Operation Guide​
Selection & Movement: Tap any outer-layer good on the shelf with your finger, press and hold, then drag it to the front row of the target grid to complete the movement (only 1 good can be moved at a time).​
Automatic Position-Filling Mechanism: When goods in a grid are eliminated, the goods behind in the same grid will automatically move forward to the front row; if the grid is empty, it can receive goods moved from other grids.​
Invalid Operation Prompt: If moving goods does not form a match-3, or the target grid is already full (with 3 goods), the system will reject the operation. The goods will automatically return to their original position without consuming a move.​ Blend shelf organization match-3 clear goods strategically for therapeutic fun!

games.description:
The Urban Rewind is a timed, multiple-choice trivia game centered on music and pop culture. Players test their knowledge across entertainment categories while managing a virtual currency system (“Mics”), unlocking achievements, and progressing through tiered levels.

Categories & Access

At launch, players have access to:
* Hip-Hop
* R&B

The TV and Movies categories are visible but locked, indicated with a lock icon.

Players begin with 3 Mics. Locked categories and additional Mics can be purchased via in-app purchases. Tapping a locked category or “Buy Mics” opens the checkout interface with the correct product and pricing.

On successful purchase:
* Mic balances or category access update immediately.
* If a category is unlocked, the user is automatically taken to that category’s “Good Luck” screen.
On failed or canceled transactions:
* The user returns to the previous screen.
* No changes are made to access or Mic balance.

Players can assign purchased Mics to specific categories from the Play screen. During active gameplay, Mics default to the current category but may be adjusted.

Gameplay & Mic Rules

Each session presents one question at a time with four answer choices (A/B/C/D). After selecting an answer, players receive immediate feedback (“Correct” or “Incorrect”) along with explanatory text.

Mics function as the attempt system:
* A player is not considered to have lost while 1 Mic remains.
* If prompted to purchase Mics at this stage, the gameplay timer resets to 10 seconds once the prompt is accepted or dismissed.
A loss occurs only when the Mic count reaches 0.
* When this happens, the session ends and a Results screen is displayed.

Each category features a cumulative badge system. All badges are grayed out at the start.

Level thresholds:
* Gold: 15 correct answers
* Platinum: 20 additional correct answers
* Multi-Platinum: 25 additional correct answers
* Diamond: 30 additional correct answers

Levels must be completed sequentially.

Once Diamond is achieved:
* The category is considered complete.
* The user is routed back to the beginning to replay the category.
* The Diamond badge remains visible until Gold is reached again during replay.

The highest level achieved in each category is permanently recorded. If a user exits or loses, they resume from the difficulty band of their highest unlocked level rather than starting from the beginning.

Audio & Sponsor Integration

Sponsor-provided background music (Artist + Title) plays on:
* Splash screen
* Login screen
* Rules screen
* Category selection screen

Music is ON by default when the app launches or when returning to the main screen. Users may tap a track to open an external link (e.g., Spotify or social media) in their browser.

During gameplay:
* Correct and Incorrect sound effects play for every question.
* On level-up, a dedicated Level-Up sound plays, and background music is temporarily paused.

UI & Session Management
Before starting any category, users see a “Good Luck” screen displaying their current level.

If a user leaves mid-session, the app saves:
* Question index
* Mic count
* Progress

Upon returning, users are prompted to Continue or Start Over.

A Results screen appears when:
* The user exits,
* A level threshold is reached, or
* Mics reach 0.

The Results screen displays total correct and incorrect answers, Mic changes, and the next milestone required for level advancement. Step up to the mic! Test your throwback knowledge in Hip-Hop, R&B, TV & movies.

Lotus Sunshine is a memory sequence game that takes place in a serene, mystical forest environment. The core challenge is simple yet deeply engaging: observe a sequence of glowing lotus flowers on a grid, then replicate the exact pattern from memory.

The game features 15 progressively difficult levels, each named after stages of natural growth, from Seedling to Eternal. Early levels present a 3x3 grid with short sequences, while advanced stages expand to 6x6 grids with longer, faster patterns that demand sharp focus and recall.

Each level operates in rounds. Successfully repeating a sequence advances the player to the next round, where one additional lotus is added to the pattern. Three lives are granted per attempt, and performance is rated with up to three stars based on the number of rounds survived.

Lotus Sunshine stands apart through its distinctive atmosphere. Every screen is set against hand-crafted forest and zen garden scenes. The interface uses custom nature-themed buttons, glowing lotus tiles, and a carefully curated green and white color palette that creates a calm, meditative experience rather than a frantic one. The game rewards patience and concentration, turning memory training into a tranquil ritual.

No timers pressure the player during input. No advertisements interrupt the flow. The design philosophy centers on clarity and immersion, letting the visual language of the forest guide the experience from the first splash screen to the final level.

games.description:
A literary mystery game where you become Sinclair.

Sinclair and Demian are irreplaceable friends who understand each other like no one else. On the day Sinclair dreams of receiving Demian’s notebook, ominous dark clouds cover the sky, and people suddenly become impulsive and violent, their eyes stained a maddening red. In an instant, the world descends into complete chaos.

Sinclair opens the strange notebook Demian once gave him. From within it, a glowing blue bird bursts forth and flies toward Demian’s house. Carrying only the notebook, Sinclair follows the blue bird—the beacon of light Demian left behind—and sets out on a perilous journey.





Sinclair’s Notebook is a point-and-click mystery thriller visual novel that reinterprets Demian, Hermann Hesse’s coming-of-age classic. One day, the world of evil—filled with blood, darkness, and immorality—emerges with ominous storm clouds and begins to consume even the world of good.

In this crisis, Demian, Sinclair’s one true confidant, has vanished. Your goal is to follow the beacon of light, find him, and uncover the truth behind what has happened.

Set against the literary atmosphere of the 1910s, the game delivers poetic emotion and delicate portrayals of the inner self inspired by the original novel. Whether you have read Demian or not, you can enjoy the story through an immersive choice-driven narrative. Choose Sinclair’s words and actions yourself, and draw closer to the truth.





Ordinary life is gone. Explore the map to uncover clues that will lead you to Demian and gather the evidence needed to support them, recording everything in your notebook.

Once you have collected enough clues and evidence, you must combine what you have gathered in the notebook and solve the situation at hand. In a world brought to a standstill, Sinclair is not simply trying to identify a criminal and bring them to justice. He must save those consumed by madness, resolve conflicts among the people entangled in each case, and investigate situations that defy all understanding.

The game also features puzzles that are approachable even for players who are new to mystery games.





Meet a wide range of characters from the original novel, each reimagined with deeper stories and new narrative layers. Sinclair’s Notebook also features charming original characters who appear only in this game.

▶ [Sinclair]🌱
A growing boy who endlessly seeks to understand himself and the world

▶ [Demian]✒️
A mysterious friend who seems to see through everything in the world

▶ [Eden]🪶
A mystical blue bird made of light

▶ [Frau Eva]🔮
Demian’s mother, a prophet who can wield magic

▶ [Father Martin]✝️
A priest who knows an important truth about the past of the church on the outskirts

Many more characters will join Sinclair’s journey throughout each chapter.

Two Iconic Games, One App

2. Tawla 31
Play the most popular variation of the region. Focus on speed and precision as you race to move your checkers across the board and bear them off before your opponent. It’s the pure, classic experience you know and love.

Real-Time Multiplayer: Match up instantly and compete against players from all over the world in live matches.

Play with Friends: Create private rooms and challenge your friends to see who is the true champion.

Authentic Design: Enjoy a beautifully clean game board, realistic physics-based dice rolls, and smooth animations optimized for all iOS devices.

Interactive Experience: Use quick emojis to react to the game and engage with your opponents during the heat of the match.

How to Play:
In Mahbuse: Roll the dice and move. If you land on a single opponent's checker, it is "trapped" and cannot move until you release it. Victory goes to the one who bears off first or effectively blocks the opponent.

In Tawla 31: It's a race to the finish. Avoid leaving single checkers vulnerable and focus on moving your entire set to the home board as quickly as possible.

7. Hardcore: No mercy. No safe picks. Extreme questions and relentless challenges that will test your absolute limits.
8. Absurd Mode: Logic left the room. Completely ridiculous, chaotic, and weird prompts for those who enjoy pure, unpredictable nonsense.

DYNAMIC LEADERBOARDS & ACHIEVEMENTS
Keep track of the action with an active in-game leaderboard that displays the current round, whose turn it is, total scores, and the number of shots taken by each player. games.name: Fan Duel
games.description:
Fan Duel is a thrilling arcade puzzle experience that combines strategy, speed, and quick decision making into one intense gameplay loop. In Fan Duel, you must navigate a compact 9 by 9 maze and reach the glowing exit before time runs out. Every round in Fan Duel presents a newly generated layout, ensuring that each attempt feels fresh, unpredictable, and engaging.

The core challenge of Fan Duel lies not only in finding the correct path but also in avoiding a relentless red pursuer that moves after every step you take. This mechanic transforms Fan Duel into a tense chase where every move matters. The further you progress, the faster the pursuer becomes, forcing you to think ahead and act quickly to survive.

Fan Duel is designed to reward both speed and smart planning. Reaching the exit quickly grants time bonuses, allowing you to build a higher score and extend your run. At the same time, Fan Duel encourages careful movement, as reckless decisions can lead you straight into danger. Balancing risk and reward is the key to mastering Fan Duel.

You start each session in Fan Duel with three hearts, giving you limited chances to make mistakes. Losing all hearts ends your run, so every step should be calculated. This adds an extra layer of tension to Fan Duel, making each round feel meaningful and exciting. The more efficiently you move and escape, the longer you stay in the game.

One of the most engaging aspects of Fan Duel is its procedural maze generation. Every maze is guaranteed to have a valid path, but the layout constantly changes, ensuring that players cannot rely on memorization. This makes Fan Duel highly replayable and keeps the experience fresh no matter how many times you play.

Fan Duel also emphasizes progression and self improvement. With each completed round, the difficulty gradually increases, testing your reflexes and decision making skills. The game motivates players to beat their personal best and discover how many rounds they can survive in Fan Duel.

The controls in Fan Duel are simple and intuitive, allowing players to focus entirely on movement and strategy. Whether you prefer quick taps or more deliberate actions, Fan Duel adapts to your playstyle and keeps the gameplay smooth and responsive.

With its minimalist design, dynamic pacing, and constant tension, Fan Duel delivers an addictive experience that is easy to pick up but difficult to master. Every round feels like a new challenge, and every escape brings a sense of accomplishment.

Step into the maze, think fast, and see how far you can go in Fan Duel. Fan Duel is a thrilling arcade puzzle experience that combines strategy,

games.name: Mythic Bouncer
games.description:
In **Mythic Bouncer**, the player finds themselves amidst ancient celestial temples, hovering high above the clouds. The hero wields a bronze shield adorned with Greek motifs—the very tool used to control the movement of a divine orb. The orb continuously ricochets off walls, the ceiling, and the hero's shield, hurtling toward the stone structures that must be destroyed. Each precise deflection alters the orb's trajectory and brings the player closer to the moment when the celestial expanse is finally cleared of these ancient edifices.

In **Mythic Bouncer**, everything revolves around the rhythm of the orb's movement and the precision of the player's reactions. The player maneuvers the shield from side to side, striving to prevent the orb from falling away. Should it slip past and vanish beyond the boundaries of the playing field, the attempt ends in the loss of a life. Thus, every bounce becomes a small test of mindfulness and control.

The stone buildings in **Mythic Bouncer** vary in size and durability. Smaller structures crumble quickly, while massive temples can withstand multiple impacts before shattering into pieces. With every hit, the stone blocks crack and gradually disintegrate, clearing the sky and earning points for the player. The more massive the building, the more challenging it is to destroy—and the more valuable the reward for a successful strike.

Occasionally, a golden artifact appears amidst the ruins. If the player manages to catch it with their shield, a rare and delightful event occurs in **Mythic Bouncer**: a second orb appears in the sky, and a lost life is restored. Now, two orbs move simultaneously along different trajectories, making the action even more dynamic and demanding the player's absolute concentration.

As the game of **Mythic Bouncer** progresses, the celestial space is gradually cleared of temples, and the pace of movement becomes increasingly rapid and precise. A mechanic that appears simple at first glance transforms into a meditative yet tense test of reflexes, where every bounce can prove decisive. Reflect the celestial orb with your shield and destroy ancient temples.

Looking for a simple, enjoyable, and strategic card game that you can play anytime without internet? This Callbreak game is designed for players who love clean gameplay, smooth controls, and a relaxing experience without unnecessary complexity.

About the Game

Callbreak (also known as Lakadi or Lakdi) is a popular trick-based card game widely played in Nepal and India. It uses a standard 52-card deck and is played among four players, where each player receives 13 cards.

The main objective is to predict (call) the number of tricks you can win in a round and then play strategically to achieve that target. Spades act as the trump suit, adding depth and decision-making to every move. The player with the highest score after all rounds wins the game.

52-card deck with spades as trump

Balanced AI behavior for fair gameplay

games.name: 5D Chess
games.description:
5D Chess reimagines the classic game of chess by introducing time travel and parallel timelines as core gameplay mechanics. Instead of playing on a single board with a linear sequence of moves, players compete across multiple boards that exist at different moments in time and across alternate realities. The result is a strategic experience that goes far beyond traditional chess.

At its foundation, the game still follows the familiar rules of chess. Pieces move in the same ways they always have: bishops diagonally, rooks along ranks and files, knights in L-shaped jumps, and so on. However, players are no longer restricted to moving pieces only within the present moment of a single board. Pieces can travel backward or forward through time, interact with earlier positions, and even create entirely new timelines.

When a piece moves into the past, it creates a branching timeline that develops independently from the original board. This produces multiple parallel versions of the game that exist simultaneously. Each timeline evolves based on the moves played within it, allowing the game to expand dynamically as new timelines are created. Players must think not only about space on a chessboard but also about how their moves affect the structure of time itself.

The interface organizes boards along a visual timeline so players can clearly track how events unfold across dimensions. Each board represents a specific point in time within a particular timeline. As the game progresses, additional boards appear, forming a network of interconnected realities. Players must monitor threats, defenses, and opportunities across these timelines simultaneously.

Because of this structure, strategy becomes dramatically more complex. A move made in the present might be countered by sending a piece into the past to alter the position before that move ever happened. Alternatively, players can create new timelines to escape dangerous situations or launch attacks that originate from different moments in time. Planning several moves ahead now involves understanding how multiple timelines may evolve in parallel.

Victory is still achieved through checkmate, but the concept expands significantly. Your king must remain safe across all active timelines while you attempt to trap your opponent’s king somewhere within the multiverse. This means that defensive play requires managing threats across many boards at once, while offensive strategies may involve coordinating attacks that originate from different timelines.

The result is a game that rewards deep planning, pattern recognition, and creative problem solving. Players who enjoy complex strategy games will find that 5D Chess offers a unique challenge that continually evolves as new timelines appear.

Features include:

Traditional chess mechanics combined with time-travel gameplay
Parallel timelines that branch when pieces move into the past
Multiple boards representing different moments in time
A clear timeline visualization system for tracking alternate realities
Complex strategic interactions across timelines and boards
Matches that evolve dynamically as new timelines form
A challenging experience for players who enjoy deep strategic thinking

Every match of 5D Chess becomes its own multiverse puzzle. Instead of calculating moves only along a single board, players must understand how their actions ripple through time and across alternate realities. A single decision can create new possibilities, new threats, and entirely new timelines that reshape the game.

Whether you are a long-time chess player or someone interested in unusual strategy games, 5D Chess offers a distinctive experience that expands the boundaries of what chess can be. Play chess across time and parallel timelines in the multiverse

games.name: Domino Association
games.description:
Domino Association is a relaxing and engaging word puzzle that challenges your mind through clever connections and satisfying logic.

On the board, you’ll find domino tiles — but instead of numbers, each half contains a word. Every word belongs to a specific category. Your goal is to match words by their shared category and clear all the tiles from the board.
Simple to learn, yet deeply satisfying to master, each level invites you to slow down, think clearly, and enjoy the process of finding the right connections.

How to Play:

- Search words that belong to the same category
- Tap on domino tiles to match them
- Clear all dominoes to complete the level
- Some tiles may block others, so the order of your moves matters. As levels progress, new categories and more complex layouts will test your attention and logic.


Think in Associations
Success comes from recognizing patterns and relationships between words. Some matches are obvious, while others require a bit more thought. Take your time and enjoy the “aha” moments as everything clicks into place.

Why You’ll Love It:

- Relaxing word gameplay with a fresh twist
- Clever category-based matching mechanics
- Clean, easy-to-read design for a comfortable experience
- Perfect balance of challenge and calm
- Ideal levels for daily mental exercise


Whether you’re unwinding after a long day or keeping your mind sharp, Domino Association offers a peaceful and rewarding puzzle experience built around the joy of words and logic. Match words by associations. Solve puzzles!

games.name: ToSaVa - Master Color Theory
games.description:
Master the art of color under pressure
ToSaVa is a fast-paced arcade puzzle designed specifically for digital artists, designers, and visual students. In this game, you don’t just play; you train your eyes and your brain to master the technical foundations of color theory in a high-pressure environment.

The Concept
You are a chameleon in a constantly changing digital world. To move forward and stay safe, you must blend in perfectly with the ground. But there’s a catch: you don’t just pick a color from a palette—you must build it manually using professional color models. Achieve a "Perfect Match" to earn stars. Getting 5 stars in a row within the same color mode will allow you to progress and unlock more advanced game modes, from RGB to the challenging Lab space.

The Professional Artist's Training Ground
The entire User Interface (UI) has been meticulously designed to mimic industry-standard software like Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and After Effects. This makes the game a perfect bridge between theory and practice, allowing you to sharpen the skills you use every day in your professional workflow.

Key Features
Three Core Mastery Modes:

HSV: Learn to think in terms of Hue, Saturation, and Value.

RGB: Master the additive color model used in every digital screen.

Lab: Challenge yourself with the most advanced, perceptually accurate color space used by high-end professionals (L*a*b).

Arcade Pressure: It’s not just about accuracy; it’s about speed. Can you calculate the correct values before the time runs out?

Educational Foundation: Developed by a 3D Animation and Interactive Environments professor as a practical tool to gamify the learning of complex visual concepts.

Minimalist & Aesthetic Design: A clean, professional look that keeps you focused on the core mechanic: the science of color.

Why play ToSaVa?
Stop guessing hex codes and start understanding how color works. Whether you are a student trying to pass your color theory exam or a senior designer looking to sharpen your "color-picking" reflexes, this game transforms a complex technical skill into an addictive arcade experience.

Think you know color? Prove it.

Fun fact: ToSaVa stands for 'To, Saturació, Valor', which is Catalan for Hue, Saturation, Value. Also, my name is Tomàs Sala, and is my first game as a SoloDev, it could be like " Version Alpha". Both are ToSaVa... Arcade challenge designed for artists. Master HSV, RGB, and Lab color spaces.
